description: Defines classes and structures for GTP-U NGU bearer reception, including state management, reordering, and timer handling, specific to the ocudu project.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_state
classes.description: Holds the state variables for GTP-U reception, including sequence numbers for next expected, delivered, and reordering.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_sdu_info
classes.description: Contains information about a received SDU, including data buffer, QoS flow ID, and sequence number.

classes.name: gtpu_tunnel_ngu_rx_impl
classes.description: Implements GTP-U NGU bearer reception with reordering, timer management, and PDU handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the reordering timer and marks the receiver as stopped.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal RX state, used for testing.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current RX state, used for testing.

methods.name: is_reordering_timer_running
methods.description: Checks if the reordering timer is active.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDU, handles reordering, duplicate detection, and SDU delivery.

methods.name: deliver_sdu
methods.description: Delivers an SDU to the lower layer.

methods.name: deliver_all_consecutive_sdus
methods.description: Delivers all in-order SDUs starting from the current delivery point.

methods.name: handle_t_reordering_expire
methods.description: Handles expiration of the reordering timer, advancing the delivery window.

methods.name: rx_mod_base
methods.description: Calculates a modulus-based base for sequence number comparison.

methods.name: inside_rx_window
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is within the current receive window.
